micro_persona_consistency.evaluation_unit: resident LLM turn grouped by persistent synthetic Agent

immediate_llm_particle_assimilation.interpretation: Mechanism consistency only: validated LLM fields are direct inputs to the particle update, so this is not independent predictive validation.

block_permutation_test.method: 49 deterministic permutations within the same branch and Tick. The test breaks the Profile or previous-state pairing while preserving the visible stage composition. Lower actual log-loss is favorable.

joint_profile_previous_state_constraint.method: Five-fold Agent-grouped multi-task ridge classification. Four matched models separate visible context, stable Profile/stake and the exact previous-Tick 10-particle state. No Agent appears in both train and test, and no post-decision particle state is used.

structured_12d_alignment.method: The validated turn contract is mapped to a 12-dimensional structured behavior vector. The same M0/M1/M2/M3 comparison separates visible context, stable Profile/stake and the exact previous-Tick particle state. No Agent appears in both train and test.

limitations: The grouped prediction test measures whether Profile/stake and previous-Tick particle state add behavioral information; it does not prove a real human identity.
Character n-gram similarity measures stable expression style, not deep semantic equivalence.
Immediate particle agreement is an implementation-consistency check because the structured LLM turn drives that update.

longitudinal_language_consistency.method: Within-Agent public-language character 1-3gram cosine compared with a different Agent matched on branch and nearest Tick. One pair per Agent/branch.

population_heterogeneity.evaluation_unit: 1,000 weighted parent Agents; 10 particles per parent quantify within-Agent uncertainty

limitations: Stake groups are synthetic issue positions, not demographic categories.
Particle dispersion is uncertainty within one Agent and is not an enlarged sample size.
Multimodality is described rather than required; a realistic population need not be bimodal on every state.
Public stance diversity is conditional on public-expression turns; silent neutral turns remain reported separately and are not relabelled as uncertainty.

interpretation_boundary: This evaluates internal simulation fidelity and mechanism behavior. It does not turn synthetic Agents into real students or establish a real policy effect.

replay_audit.terminal_tick_note: The formal public result remains complete through Tick 10. Full-particle reconstruction stops at Tick 9 because the later improved renderer replaced the old prompt bytes and terminal turns have no next-tick persona audit key.
